name: Clockwork Wonder

source.title: Pathfinder Society Clockwork Mystery Player's Guide

text:
You have a knack for clockwork magic and can see how it all links together. You were recommended to the Society by a mutual friend due to your expertise.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Clockwork Lore skill. You gain the Improvise Tool skill feat.
